profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at SAP
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry with a Master of Science Degree focused on Computer Information Systems from Boston University. Full Stack Software Developer responsible for building rich client web applications and web services for desktop and mobile devices. Skilled in Angular, Node, Google Material, Typescript/JavaScript, Docker, Kubernetes and Agile Methodologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Web Developer responsible for building rich client web applications for desktop and mobile devices. Performs code development, developer testing and unit testing on the SAP FSM stack (Angular, Node.JS, Google Material, Typescript/JavaScript, Docker, Kubernets) during sprints cycles, prepares proof of concepts/feasibility studies, and/or delivery of product releases.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Software Developer responsible for building rich client web applications in the browser for desktop and mobile devices. Performs web development and unit testing on the Coresystems stack (Angular, Node.JS, Google Material, Typescript/JavaScript) during sprints cycles, prepares proof of concepts/feasibility studies, and/or delivery of product releases.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for design, development, unit testing, feature testing and delivery of graphical user interface infrastructures and enhancements using Flex and Java. Design of experiments and prototypes needed to evaluate and establish technical direction, analyze potential solutions and identify problematic areas. Work closely with quality assurance and development teams distributed across different countries to coordinate deliverable components and integration.
